title: Mashed Potatoes

items: 5 lb mix of russet and Yukon Gold potatoes

steps: Peel and cut potatoes into roughly equal 1-2” chunks and rinse under cold water to remove excess starch.
Add to a large pot and cover with 1” of water and bring to a boil. Add garlic if using.
Cook for 30 to 35 minutes. A fork or knife should easily pierce the potatoes with no resistance, and the potatoes should almost, but not totally, fall apart.
Drain the potatoes in a large colander then add back to the large pot. Mash the potatoes over low heat to gradually dry the potatoes.
Add the butter, cream cheese, and half-and-half. Continue mashing.
Place in a baking dish, add a couple slices of butter, then bake at 350F until the butter is melted and the potatoes are piping hot.
